notes.title: Please don't hurt me! - Aracore update 1.4
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/69b1a300422de51a94b3796e9c761793167d98a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Additional mission added![/h1][p][/p][p]After analysing ongoing pilot feedback, Haaris has decided to take new pilots under his wing. After his scans revealed a potential asteroid strike on Ara base, Haaris now offers to take new pilots on a mining mission with the hopes of avoiding chaos![/p][list][*][p]Added a new mining mission![/p][list][*][p]After the tutorial stage, players may now opt to go on a new mission with Haaris[/p][/*][*][p]This mission allows players to skip the asteroid strike and clean-up missions[/p][/*][*][p]Players may choose the (more clearly labelled) more difficult mission if they're sadists[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an 'engine power' key: hold for finer movement control[/p][/*][*][p]Added an in-game link to the DIscord channel: join if you want to get involved in the game![/p][/*][*][p]Updated dialogue[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Join the Discord![/h1][p]If you want to be involved in development, get access to the beta-version of the full game (now around 80% complete), and give your own suggestions, join the [url="https://discord.gg/bxkgn3nTVP"]El Crabo Grande Game Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]Next Update[/h1][p]Some players are having issues with sound. If you have no sound or no music (which is a terrible shame, as the music is awesome), please post in the discussion board or Discord and I'll find a fix, which may involve ripping out the current sound engine and replacing it.[/p][p][b]Any feedback on the changes is always welcome! [/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Improvements & Fixes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/d87794fd0544dd170ee65ab8013bfdd04f0ccccd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Updated controls and interface[/h1][p][/p][p]After listening to pilot feedback, Aracore Chief Operations Officer and engineering mastermind Tully has completed drone upgrades! Details below:[/p][list][*][p]Added lateral thrusters to drones (to move sideways)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased power of reverse thrusters[/p][/*][*][p]Added targeting overlay (enabled/disabled in ship systems menu)[/p][/*][*][p]Added ammo count interface[/p][/*][/list][p]Slightly bigger is the control scheme update:[/p][list][*][p]Added keyboard-and-mouse controls, using a visible cursor that the ship rotates towards[/p][/*][*][p]Added two different gamepad mappings (dual-stick and dpad)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Any feedback on the changes is always welcome! [/b]Do we need a 'reduced engine power' mode where speed and rotation is slower?[/p][p][/p][h1]Future difficulty adjustments[/h1][p][/p][p]The second biggest issue for many in the demo was the difficulty of the asteroid-strike intro stage (now appropriately renamed "Impossible Odds". I'm planning on adding an alternate stage with some peaceful mining (the asteroid strike will still happen in the story, you'll just not have to deal with it!) and making it clear that there's an "action" route and a "peaceful" through the game that the player can choose.[/p][p]As it is, for most of the rest of the game, the player will be choosing (sometimes indirectly, sometimes directly) to opt for mining missions, where time is not an issue, and chaos is minimal, or play the more action-oriented corporate espionage missions, so it makes sense to start the game as it goes on![/p][p][/p][h1]Special Thanks[/h1][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to the various players who've posted suggestions and issues that allowed some bug fixes and improvements![/p][p][/p][p]I'm tired now, so I'm going to bed.[/p]

notes.title: AraCore Astromining Ventures Demo launched!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129711/e7924a830beb1becbd6e6bbbb2024041bd471994.png[/img]
The AraCore Astromining Ventures Demo is now available on Steam! 

The demo includes the first four stages of the game, where you'll be introduced to AraCore and its employees, complete (or mess up) several missions on each stage, and earn your first paycheck. Plenty of secrets await as your adventure begins, immersing you in the dystopian world of the corporate-driven astromining future.

If you like it, please let me know!

notes.title: AraCore Astromining Ventures Demo available soon!
notes.notes:
After quite a lot of work, the AraCore Astromining Ventures Demo is nearly ready for public release on Steam! If you'd like to participate in the beta test and gain early access to the demo, reach out via the community hub on Steam, join us on Discord, or leave a comment on our YouTube channel.

The demo includes the first four stages of the game, where you'll be introduced to AraCore and its employees, complete (or mess up) several missions on each stage, and earn your first paycheck. Plenty of secrets await as your adventure begins, immersing you in the dystopian world of the corporate-driven astromining future.
